scope: Not part of the Western Cape Sprint 5 pattern test. These pins do not feed its predictions, scoring, thresholds or the arrest-gap comparison (tools/checked_signals.py: pattern_test_pins). Collection window: incidents 1-22 Oct 2026; Phiphidi (30 Sep) is outside it and excluded.
rules: Standalone signals: no case, entity or map-line links. Incident date kept apart from report date. Pin = the place the source gives; 'approx.' in the title when only a street, suburb, area or village is known. Sources that reuse one report or one police statement are not independent corroboration. Being near another pin is not a link. Private individuals (victims and suspects) are not named; exception by owner decision of 22 Oct 2026: pin G names the comedian by his public stage name, Skeem Mafenya, as reported. Estimated map points (pins C and E): where the village could not be placed on a map, the pin is the SAPS station point of the police precinct that handled the case, used only as a reference; the title says 'map point estimated', the drawer location note starts 'ESTIMATED MAP POINT', and the precision is 'precinct' with an uncertainty equal to the farthest edge of that precinct from the station. OpenStreetMap (Overpass) searches for these villages returned no data at all; they neither confirm nor rule out that a village is mapped. Every fact-base quote matched word for word against the saved source text.
review_status: Prepared for owner review on a local review branch. No approval record exists for any pin in this file; publication needs the owner's approval.

owner_decisions.decision: Prepare A, B, F, G and H for publication review.

Owner's words: "stop the activity to locate Rostock and Siburung, and basically just use what you can based on the screenshots. So the district and the police precinct, and it will be noted in the uh drawers showing that it's an estimate."

Coverage areas: keep Giyani (F, Nkuri-Tomu) and Malamulele (G, Madonsi Boltman B) as separate areas. They are in different police precincts, and the Limpopo same-precinct rule in tools/coverage_areas.py (PRECINCT_SPLIT_PROVINCES) splits them. Owner's word: "Apart".
None of this is approval to publish. Publication of each pin still needs the owner's approval.

signals.title: Mamaolo village, Ga-Mphahlele (Maribeng Section, approx.): tavern owner, 53, found murdered and robbed, 2 Oct
signals.content: Police say a 53-year-old tavern owner was found by his sister at his business premises at Ga-Mphahlele, Maribeng Section, in Mamaolo village outside Lebowakgomo. The garage doors were open and he was lying face down in a pool of blood after being struck with a sharp object; cash and his white Isuzu bakkie were taken (police spokesperson Hlulani Mashaba, via SABC News). Lebowakgomo police are investigating business robbery and murder and launched a manhunt. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. One public report, resting on police: SABC News, 3 October; the SAPS Limpopo media statement says the same. The pin is approximate (village level).

signals.title: Near Peter Mokaba Stadium, Polokwane (approx.): man, 29, assaulted by a group, dies in hospital, 4 Oct
signals.content: Police say a 29-year-old man was seriously injured in a confrontation with a group of people near the stadium in the early hours of 4 October, after the Shandesh One Woman Show at the Peter Mokaba rugby field, and was later certified dead in hospital. A friend who arrived to collect him fired one shot from his licensed firearm and the group dispersed; police seized the firearm for ballistic analysis. The case is investigated as murder; no arrests, though police say they have strong leads (police spokesperson Sergeant Maphure Manamela, via Review Online). Police have not confirmed whether this death is connected to the event. The victim is not named here. One report, resting on police: Review Online, 16 October. The pin is approximate: the stadium's map point, not the scene.

signals.title: Rostock village, Mecklenburg police area (map point estimated): man, 18, dies after mob attack, 11 Oct
signals.content: Police say an 18-year-old man died after community members, who accused him of trying to rob a foreign-owned shop in Rostock village, attacked him with sticks, stones and cables at about 18:00 on Sunday 11 October. His family took him from the scene while he was still breathing; he died on arrival at a local hospital (police spokesperson Col Malesela Ledwaba, via TimesLIVE and SABC News). Mecklenburg police opened a murder case and are looking for the suspects, who have not been identified. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. Two reports, both resting on the same police statement: TimesLIVE and SABC News. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: Rostock village could not be placed on a map, so the pin sits on the Mecklenburg police station, the police area that handled the case. It is not the scene; the village may be up to about 27 km away.

signals.title: Malope Section, Masemola police area (approx.): man dies after being held as a burglary suspect; two charged with murder, 13 Oct
signals.content: Police say they responded to a complaint of a residential burglary in progress at about 04:00 on Tuesday 13 October at Malope Section in the Masemola policing area, Sekhukhune District. They found an adult man lying on the floor with visible injuries; he was unresponsive and was later declared dead. Police say he was allegedly apprehended by people who suspected him of being involved in a burglary at the residence; the circumstances of his death are under investigation. Two suspects, aged 29 and 32, were arrested and charged with murder, due in the Nebo Magistrate's Court on 15 October (SAPS, on X, 14 October). The man is not named here. One source: the police post itself; no news report found. The pin is approximate: a wide town-level point for Ga-Masemola, not the scene.

signals.title: Sekurung village, Lebowakgomo police area (map point estimated): girl, 2, taken from home and killed; woman, 20, arrested, 13 Oct
signals.content: Police say a two-year-old girl was taken from her home at Sekurung village and fatally stabbed; she also had burn wounds, as the suspect allegedly set fire to the child's home before leaving with her. Police responding to a kidnapping report at about 11:55 on Tuesday 13 October found community members gathered on Sekurung Mountain, where the child's body was found. A 20-year-old woman who was still at the scene was arrested for murder; police also opened a case of malicious damage to property. Afterwards some community members allegedly set the suspect's house alight. The motive is unclear (police, via Review Online and Limpopo Chronicle). No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: Sekurung could not be placed on a map, so the pin sits on the Lebowakgomo police station, the police area that handled the case. It is not the scene; the village may be up to about 32 km away.

signals.title: Nkuri-Tomu village, near Giyani (approx.): woman, 35, shot dead at home; husband, 73, arrested, 13 Oct
signals.content: Police say a 35-year-old woman was shot dead at about 11 pm on Tuesday 13 October at a house in Nkuri-Tomu village near Giyani. Officers on patrol received a complaint about a shooting and were directed to the house by the victim's brother-in-law; she was lying in the sitting room with multiple gunshot wounds to her head and upper body, with a steel axe and ammunition next to her, and was declared dead at the scene. Her 73-year-old husband was arrested at the house and a firearm seized; police say domestic violence has not been ruled out (police spokesperson Malesela Ledwaba, via Jacaranda FM). No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police: Jacaranda FM and Daily Sun. The pin is approximate (village level).

signals.title: Madonsi Boltman B, Malamulele (approx.): comedian Skeem Mafenya, 20, stabbed to death; three arrested, 17 Oct
signals.content: Police say 20-year-old comedian and content creator Skeem Mafenya was found lying motionless inside a yard at Madonsi Boltman B, in the Malamulele policing area, with multiple stab wounds to his upper body after a report at about 03:35 on Saturday 17 October; he was declared dead at the scene. A community member had heard a knock and seen a man bleeding through a window. Three suspects aged 17 to 23 were arrested hours later, police told EWN; the motive is unknown. SABC News names the place as Madonsi-Shitasini village and says he was stabbed by a group of men near a tavern. Three reports, all resting on police: EWN, Limpopo Chronicle and SABC News. He is named here by his public stage name, by the owner's decision of 22 October. The pin is approximate (village level).

signals.title: Martinique village, Villa Nora police area (approx.): woman, 35, shot dead; police sergeant suspect later found dead, 21 Oct
signals.content: Police say a 39-year-old police sergeant stationed at Witpoort police station allegedly shot his 35-year-old wife dead on Wednesday 21 October in Martinique village, in the Villa Nora policing area; she was declared dead at the scene. He fled in his white Isuzu bakkie. At about 06:30 on Thursday 22 October police found the bakkie parked along the road in Botshabelo Section, Tom Burke policing area, about 100 metres from his body under a marula tree, with a gunshot wound to the head and his state-issued firearm next to him. An inquest docket was opened at Tom Burke. Motive unknown; domestic violence not ruled out (police spokesperson Col Malesela Ledwaba, via TimesLIVE). TimesLIVE's opening line says Abbotspoort village; its own report and police place the shooting in Martinique village. No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police: TimesLIVE and Limpopo Chronicle. The suspect is a police officer. The pin is approximate (village level).
